name.ja: HGUC 1/144 キュベレイＭｋ-ＩＩ （プルツー専用機）
name.en: HGUC 1/144 Qubeley Mk-II (Pull Two exclusive machine)

description.ja: 『機動戦士ガンダムＺＺ』　赤いキュベレイＭｋ－II プルツー専用機、ＨＧＵＣで初登場！
description.en: "Mobile Suit Gundam ZZ" Red Qubeley Mk-II Pluto exclusive machine makes its first appearance in HGUC!

description.ja: 新生-ＲＥＶＩＶＥ-ＨＧＵＣキットで、プルツー操るキュベレイＭｋ-IIを１／１４４初キット化！（※）
description.en: New-REVIVE-HGUCKit is the first 1/144 kit of Qubeley Mk-II that can be operated by pull-two! (*)

description.ja: （※）限定発売アイテムを除く
description.en: (*) Excluding limited release items

description.ja: 印象的なカラーを成形色で再現し、３本のビーム照射を再現するサーベルを新規造形で付属！
description.en: The impressive colors are reproduced with molded colors, and a newly molded saber that reproduces the irradiation of three beams is included!

description.ja: ●　劇中に登場するカラーを成形色で再現！
description.en: ● Reproduce the colors that appear in the play with molded colors!

description.ja: ●　３本のビーム刃をジョイントするサーベルグリップを新規型で再現！！
description.en: ● Reproduce the saber grip that joints three beam blades with a new type! !

description.ja: ●　Ｍｋ-II特有の肩部マーキングもシールで再現！
description.en: ● The shoulder markings unique to Mk-II are also reproduced with Seal!

description.ja: ●　キットは、新生-ＲＥＶＩＶＥ-ＨＧＵＣ！
description.en: ● Kit is a new-REVIVE-HGUC!

description.ja: より洗練されたプロポーションをもち、可動域の幅を広げ、劇中のさまざまなポージングの演出が可能。
description.en: It has more sophisticated proportions and a wider range of motion, allowing for various poses in the play.
